note: Indicators and warning. Each indicator names what is watched, the threshold that changes its status, and the source. The run sets status (green, amber, red) each day it has the fact and appends to history only on a change, with the date, the new status and the fact that moved it. Numeric indicators name a world-series key and a rule so the page can show the latest value.

items.name: Drones and missiles launched at Ukraine, 7-day mean
items.threshold: amber above 200 a night, red above 300

history.t: 227 launched overnight into 6 Nov; the seven-day mean sits above 200. [UAF]

items.name: Russia–Ukraine talks: a trilateral round held with named delegations
items.threshold: amber when a round is scheduled, green when held, red when cancelled

history.t: Putin named 10 Nov in Abu Dhabi; Umerov leads Ukraine's delegation.

items.name: Druzhba crude flowing to Slovakia and Hungary
items.threshold: amber on any interruption, red beyond 48 hours

items.name: Hungary–EU agreement on frozen cohesion funds signed
items.threshold: amber while negotiating, green when signed, red if talks break off

history.t: Negotiation on about $20bn continues; no text published.

items.name: Slovakia: snap election called
items.threshold: amber when the prime minister threatens one, red when parliament votes to shorten its term
items.src: National Council of the Slovak Republic, TASR

history.t: Fico threatened snap elections in a televised debate, suggesting January 2027.
Fico ruled out early elections after losing his majority. [87]

items.name: FY27 NDAA: conference report filed
items.threshold: amber while the chambers' bills differ, green when the conference report is filed

history.t: House and Senate versions passed; conference not yet reported.

items.name: Hybrid incidents logged in Europe, 7 days

history.t: Below the amber line this week.
17 incidents logged 2–8 Nov, led by the cold-chain cyberattacks and the airliner hoaxes. [74, 13]

items.name: Northern Fleet live-fire warning areas active in the Barents Sea
items.threshold: amber when NOTAMs are active, red when they overlap Norway's EEZ
items.src: The Barents Observer, Norwegian NOTAM office

history.t: Overlapping NOTAMs near Franz Josef Land, Rybachy and Novaya Zemlya.

items.name: PLA aircraft around Taiwan, 7-day mean
items.threshold: amber above 30 a day, red above 60
items.src: Taiwan Ministry of National Defence daily report

history.t: Seeded at green; the run sets the first measured status.

items.name: USD/EUR below 0.85 (a weaker dollar for a euro budget)

history.t: Seeded; the page reads the rate from fx.json.

items.name: Hoax bomb threats against flights in Europe, per day
items.threshold: amber on a day with 5 or more flights hit, red above 20
items.src: Prosecutors, airport police and airline statements via AFP

history.t: No new flight hoax reported on 7 Nov after at least 17 flights on 6 Nov; Paris opened a probe. [13]

items.name: Exploited vulnerabilities added to the CISA catalog, 7 days
items.threshold: amber above 8, red above 15, or red on any one exploited in European critical infrastructure
items.src: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog (JSON feed)

history.t: Three entries added 2 to 8 Nov (catalog 2026.11.06, 1,769 entries); the October weekly peak was six on 20 Oct. [CISA KEV]

items.name: New EU/EEA communicable-disease threat in the ECDC weekly report
items.threshold: amber when the report opens a new EU/EEA event with local transmission, red when WHO declares a public-health emergency or an EU country reports community transmission of a novel pathogen
items.src: ECDC public health events page (it replaced the weekly Communicable Disease Threats Report in October 2026; the last weekly report is week 42, 10 to 16 Oct)

history.t: Provisional: opened 8 Nov; the latest report listed by ECDC on 8 Nov is week 42 (10 to 16 Oct). The run reads each new report and sets the status from it. [ECDC CDTR]
